## Finding

The failure does not occur on r17158. The ticket's `bitintivarargs.c` is
`tests/bitintvararg.c.in` in trunk, and a guard in it that names this ticket skips width 33 for
mcs51. After the guard is removed, the 33-bit case passes for mcs51 in the small and large models,
each with and without `--stack-auto`. The revision that corrected the behavior was not identified.

## Fix

The patch removes the guard. It changes no compiler source.
